body:
> Also with the new connector of v2, this wouldn't require a change, just a new rendering.

@bobylito Sorry to resurrect this thread, but I dug into this and have some follow-up questions.

So, I ended up getting this working simply by copying https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/feat/instantsearch.js/v2/src/widgets/refinement-list/refinement-list.js into my project, making all the import references non-relative, and tweaking what I needed to.

Works, but still seems like overkill for this particular tweak (since I wanted to keep 99% of the default refinementList rendering). Perhaps there should be an easier way to add data to the templates? Assuming I could get at the facet value counts, it seems like adding `header` to `RefinementListTransforms` could be a way to achieve this: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/refinementList.html#struct-RefinementListTransforms

Let me know what you think.
